A soul-stirring musical journey by Jubair Muhammed
Immerse yourself in the emotional and melodic depth of "Kasavinal", a beautifully composed and powerfully sung track by Jubair Muhammed. Blending heartfelt lyrics with captivating visuals, this song takes you through themes of love, longing, and reflection.
Music - Jubair Muhammed
Singers - Jubair Muhammed | Hanan Shaah
Lyricist - Suhail Sulthan
